QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions.

Need something more specific?
Ask Pure Knight ↗

How does the 14-day trial work?

Choose a plan, verify your email and complete secure checkout. Your workspace is created automatically after checkout confirms the subscription. It starts in demo mode, with your signup email as the demo recipient. Demo mode stays locked throughout the trial and until a paid subscription is active. After payment, an administrator can deliberately switch to live sending in settings. The first eligible trial lasts 14 days; the selected paid plan then begins unless cancelled. Payment details are collected securely by Stripe. We warn you before the trial ends. You can cancel in your workspace billing settings before the paid plan starts.

What happens to an unused trial workspace?

Unpaid cancelled trial workspaces are permanently deleted after 60 days of inactivity following trial expiry. We send warning emails 14 days, 7 days and 1 day beforehand. Signing in postpones the inactivity deadline. Paid accounts are excluded.

Does Starter include AI?

No. Starter focuses on manual estimating, the product library, customer and project management, and branded quotations. AI-assisted email and attachment processing is reserved for Professional and Business.

Which plan includes Sage or Xero?

Accounting exports are planned for Business only. They are not yet available and are not included in Starter or Professional. We’ll confirm exactly what’s supported before it goes live.

Can I purchase directly from the pricing page?

Yes. Choose a plan to verify your email and subscribe through secure Stripe Checkout. StoneFlow then creates your company workspace automatically and emails your sign-in details.

Is this designed for wetcast, semi-dry and GRC?

Yes. StoneFlow supports configurable materials, densities and pricing methods, including area and volume pricing. Your rates and review process stay under your company’s control. Complex profiles and technical exceptions still need estimator review.
